title: Quantized model fallback costing playbook and enterprise transition triggers
creator: Aisha Nair
description:
Background: Enterprise customers frequently ask for quantized model variants to reduce cost, but are concerned about regressions in quality and supportability. We need a reproducible playbook that ties quantized-model fallback policies to clear cost thresholds and transition triggers so Platform/Customer Success can recommend safe, measurable switch paths for production workloads.

Objective: Produce a decision playbook and costing model that defines: 1) when to recommend quantized variants as primary or fallback, 2) the measurable thresholds (latency, p50/p95, per-token cost delta, quality delta on canonical evals) that trigger an enforced or suggested switch, and 3) an automated checklist for Dedicated/Private transition with observability hooks and rollback paths.

Scope: - Focus on compact and int8/4-bit quantized variants of popular open models in our catalog. - Cover hosted and Dedicated deployments; include guidance for Private (VPC) where KMS/upgrade cadence matters. - Deliver a spreadsheet costing model, a one-page playbook for Customer Success, and an internal runbook for SRE/Oncall.

Out of scope: Per-model fine-tuning decisions and non-quantization compression techniques (pruning, distillation) which will be captured in a follow-up project.
acceptance_criteria: Cost model spreadsheet that computes per-token and per-request cost delta between baseline and quantized variants for common seq-lengths (32/128/512)
Playbook PDF (1 page) summarizing recommended fallback policies, required observability checks, and example customer messaging
Runbook that lists automated circuit-breaker thresholds, rollback steps, and required SLO updates for Dedicated clusters
Pilot checklist validated with two existing enterprise customers (one Hosted, one Dedicated) and documented feedback
Links to eval prompt sets and canonical metrics (EMB/QA/fluency) demonstrating acceptable quality deltas <= configured thresholds
tasks: Collect perf & cost baselines for selected models (LLAMA-like-7B, mix-quant-13B, open-compact-3B)
Define canonical eval prompt sets per vertical (search, summarization, assistants) with PM/Research
Build per-sequence-length cost calculator prototype (spreadsheet + scripted extractor)
Draft one-page playbook for CS and a technical runbook for SRE
Run 2 pilot rollouts and capture telemetry for p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and quality regression
Finalize thresholds and publish playbook to Confluence; schedule training session with Solutions Eng

risk_assessment: Medium: Quantization gives meaningful cost upside but has measurable quality risk for certain vertical prompts. Risk is mitigated by pilot validations, canonical eval gating, and automated rollback. Dedicated rollout requires coordination with capacity reservations and possible SLA updates.
measurement_metrics: Per-token cost delta (baseline vs quant) by seq-length
Quality delta on canonical evals (ROUGE/BLEU/semantic-similarity) per vertical
Adoption rate post-playbook (fraction of eligible requests switched within 90d)
